items.sentence: The kind of knowledge students acquire when they go to school and they learn how to be students ___ what educators call the ‘hidden curriculum.’
items.prompt: 문장 전체의 동사로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 주어 중심은 단수 The kind입니다. students acquire ...는 The kind of knowledge를 수식하는 생략된 관계사절이므로 본동사는 forms입니다.
items.memory: 명사 뒤 절의 동사와 문장 전체 본동사를 구별

items.sentence: The hidden curriculum refers to all the unspoken beliefs and procedures that regulate classroom life — the rules of the game no one writes down but that teachers and students have internalized in their expectations about each other.
items.prompt: the rules of the game 뒤에서 but으로 연결된 두 번째 관계사절을 드래그하세요.
items.answer: that teachers and students have internalized in their expectations about each other
items.explanation: no one writes down과 that teachers and students have internalized ...가 but으로 병렬 연결되어 the rules of the game을 수식합니다.

items.sentence: Today, the average French meal has been slashed down to 38 minutes, and wine consumption decline consequently ___ to us a by-product of the emergence of the faster, more modern, on-the-go lifestyle.
items.prompt: wine consumption decline 뒤의 본동사로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 여기서 decline은 동사가 아니라 ‘감소’라는 명사로 wine consumption과 함께 주어를 이룹니다. 따라서 단수동사 seems가 본동사입니다.

items.sentence: Children can learn to build relationships of trust, assuming that social interactions involving the children are conducted fairly and their opinions are respected.
items.prompt: assuming that의 의미로 가장 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 분사형 assuming이 접속사처럼 쓰여 ‘~라고 가정하면’이라는 조건 의미를 나타냅니다.

items.sentence: Our ancestors probably consoled each other with hugs and pats long before they learned how to talk, but once language was invented they found a new way of providing consolation by offering words of sympathy and advice.
items.prompt: once language was invented에서 once의 의미로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 문맥상 언어가 발명된 뒤 바로 새로운 위로 방식이 생겼다는 흐름이므로 once는 ‘~하자마자’의 접속사입니다.
